G3303.def: a primary particle; properly, indicative of affirmation or concession (in fact); usually followed by a contrasted clause with «1161» (this one, the former, etc.):--even, indeed, so, some, truly, verily. Often compounded with other particles in an intensive or asseverative sense.

G3304.def: from «3203» and «3767» and «1065»; so then at least:--nay but, yea doubtless (rather, verily).

G3305.def: from «3203» and «5104»; indeed though, i.e. however:--also, but, howbeit, nevertheless, yet.

G3306.def: a primary verb; to stay (in a given place, state, relation or expectancy):--abide, continue, dwell, endure, be present, remain, stand, tarry (for), × thine own.

G3307.def: from «3313»; to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or (figuratively) to disunite, differ:--deal, be difference between, distribute, divide, give participle

G3308.def: from «3307» (through the idea of distraction); solicitude:--care.

G3309.def: from «3308»; to be anxious about:--(be, have) care(-ful), take thought.

G3310.def: feminine of «3313»; a portion, i.e. province, share or (abstractly) participation:--part (X -akers).

G3311.def: from «3307»; a separation or distribution:--dividing asunder, gift.

G3313.et: from an obsolete but more primary form of meiromai (to get as a section or allotment)
G3313.def: from an obsolete but more primary form of meiromai (to get as a section or allotment); a division or share (literally or figuratively, in a wide application):--behalf, course, coast, craft, particular (+ -ly), part (+ -ly), piece, portion, respect, side, some sort(-what).

G3314.def: from «3319» and «2250»; midday; by implication, the south:--noon, south.

G3315.def: from «3316»; to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify (as surety):--confirm.

G3316.def: from «3319»; a go-between, i.e. (simply) an internunciator, or (by implication) a reconciler (intercessor):--mediator.

G3317.def: neuter of compound of «3319» and «3571»; midnight (especially as a watch):--midnight.

G3318.def: from «3319» and «4215»; Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and the Tigris; compare 0763), a region of Asia:--Mesopotamia.

G3319.def: from «3326»; middle (as an adjective or (neuter) noun):--among, × before them, between, + forth, mid(-day, -night), midst, way.

G3321.et: from a presumed compound of (3319) and (3772)
G3321.def: from a presumed compound of «3319» and «3772»; mid-sky:--midst of heaven.

G3322.def: from «3319»; to form the middle, i.e. (in point of time), to be half-way over:--be about the midst.

G3323.def: of Hebrew origin («04899»); the Messias (i.e. Mashiach), or Christ:--Messias.

G3325.def: from «3324»; to replenish, i.e. (by implication) to intoxicate:--fill.

G3326.def: a primary preposition (often used adverbially); properly, denoting accompaniment; "amid" (local or causal); modified variously according to the case (genitive association, or accusative succession) with which it is joined; occupying an intermediate position between «575» or «1537» and «1519» or «4314»; less intimate than «1722» and less close than «4862»):--after(-ward), × that he again, against, among, × and, + follow, hence, hereafter, in, of, (up-)on, + our, × and setting, since, (un-)to, + together, when, with (+ -out). Often used in composition, in substantially the same relations of participation or proximity, and transfer or sequence.

G3327.def: from «3326» and the base of «939»; to change place:--depart, go, pass, remove.

G3328.def: from «3326» and «906»; to throw over, i.e. (middle voice figuratively) to turn about in opinion:--change mind.

G3329.def: from «3326» and «718»; to lead over, i.e. transfer (direct):--turn about.

G3330.def: from «3326» and «1325»; to give over, i.e. share:--give, impart.

G3331.def: from «3346»; transposition, i.e. transferral (to heaven), disestablishment (of a law):--change, removing, translation.

G3332.def: from «3326» and «142»; to betake oneself, i.e. remove (locally):--depart.

G3333.def: from «3326» and «2564»; to call elsewhere, i.e. summon:--call (for, hither).

G3334.def: from «3326» and «2795»; to stir to a place elsewhere, i.e. remove (figuratively):--move away.

G3335.def: from «3326» and «2983»; to participate; genitive case, to accept (and use):--eat, have, be partaker, receive, take.

G3338.et: from (3326) and the middle voice of (3199)
G3338.def: from «3326» and the middle voice of «3199»; to care afterwards, i.e. regret:--repent (self).

G3339.def: from «3326» and «3445»; to transform (literally or figuratively, "metamorphose"):--change, transfigure, transform.

G3340.def: from «3326» and «3539»; to think differently or afterwards, i.e. reconsider (morally, feel compunction):--repent.

G3341.def: from «3340»; (subjectively) compunction (for guilt, including reformation); by implication, reversal (of (another's) decision):--repentance.

G3342.def: from «3326» and a form of «4862»; betwixt (of place or person); (of time) as adjective, intervening, or (by implication) adjoining:--between, mean while, next.

G3343.def: from «3326» and «3992»; to send from elsewhere, i.e. (middle voice) to summon or invite:--call (send) foreign

G3344.def: from «3326» and «4762»; to turn across, i.e. transmute or (figuratively) corrupt:--pervert, turn.

G3345.def: from «3326» and a derivative of «4976»; to transfigure or disguise; figuratively, to apply (by accommodation):--transfer, transform (self).

G3346.def: from «3326» and «5087»; to transfer, i.e. (literally) transport, (by implication) exchange, (reflexively) change sides, or (figuratively) pervert:--carry over, change, remove, translate, turn.

G3348.def: from «3326» and «2192»; to share or participate; by implication, belong to, eat (or drink):--be partaker, pertain, take part, use.

G3349.et: from a compound of (3326) and a collateral form of (142) or perhaps rather (109) (cf "meteor")
G3349.def: from a compound of «3326» and a collateral form of «142» or perhaps rather «109» (compare "meteor"); to raise in mid-air, i.e. (figuratively) suspend (passively, fluctuate or be anxious):--be of doubtful mind.

G3350.et: from a derivative of a compound of (3326) and (3624)
G3350.def: from a derivative of a compound of «3326» and «3624»; a change of abode, i.e. (specially), expatriation:--X brought, carried(-ying) away (in-)to.

G3351.def: from the same as «3350»; to transfer as a settler or captive, i.e colonize or exile:--carry away, remove into.

G3353.def: from «3348»; participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an associate:--fellow, partaker, partner.

G3354.def: from «3358»; to measure (i.e. ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by implication, to admeasure (i.e. allot by rule):--figuratively, to estimate:--measure, mete.

G3355.def: from «3354»; a measurer, i.e. (specially), a certain standard measure of capacity for liquids:--firkin.

G3356.et: from a compound of the base of (3357) and (3806)
G3356.def: from a compound of the base of «3357» and «3806»; to be moderate in passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently):--have compassion.

G3357.def: adverb from a derivative of «3358»; moderately, i.e. slightly:--a little.

G3358.def: an apparently primary word; a measure ("metre"), literally or figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree):-- measure.

G3359.def: from «3326» and ops (the face); the forehead (as opposite the countenance):--forehead.

G3360.def: from «3372»; as far as, i.e. up to a certain point (as a preposition, of extent (denoting the terminus, whereas «891» refers especially to the space of time or place intervening) or conjunction):--till, (un-)to, until.

G3361.et: a primary particle of qualified negation (whereas (3756) expresses an absolute denial)
G3361.def: a primary particle of qualified negation (whereas «3756» expresses an absolute denial); (adverb) not, (conjunction) lest; also (as an interrogative implying a negative answer (whereas «3756» expects an affirmative one)) whether:--any but (that), × forbear, + God forbid, + lack, lest, neither, never, no (X wise in), none, nor, (can-)not, nothing, that not, un(-taken), without. Often used in compounds in substantially the same relations. See also «3362», «3363», «3364», «3372», «3373», «3375», «3378».

G3362.def: i.e. «1437» and «3361»; if not, i.e. unless:--X before, but, except, if, no, (if, + whosoever) not.

G3363.def: i.e. «2443» and «3361»; in order (or so) that not:--albeit not, lest, that, no(-t, (-thing)).

G3364.pos: 1. never, certainly not, not at all, by no means
G3364.def: i.e. «3756» and «3361»; a double negative strengthening the denial; not at all:--any more, at all, by any (no) means, neither, never, no (at all), in no case (wise), nor ever, not (at all, in any wise). Compare «3378».

G3365.et: from a compound of (3361) and amos (somebody)
G3365.def: adverb from a compound of «3361» and amos (somebody); by no means:--not so.

G3366.pos: 1. and not, but not, nor, not
G3366.def: from «3361» and «1161»; but not, not even; in a continued negation, nor:--neither, nor (yet), (no) not (once, so much as).

G3367.def: from «3361» and «1520»; not even one (man, woman, thing):--any (man, thing), no (man), none, not (at all, any man, a whit), nothing, + without delay.

G3369.def: from «3366» and «4452»; not even yet:--not yet.

G3370.def: of foreign origin (compare «04074»); a Median, or inhabitant of Media:--Mede.

G3371.def: from «3361» and «2089»; no further:--any longer, (not) henceforth, hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more.

G3372.def: probably akin to «3173»; length (literally or figuratively) length.

G3373.def: from «3372»; to lengthen, i.e. (middle voice) to enlarge:--grow up.

G3375.def: a stronger form of «3303»; a particle of affirmation (only with «2229»); assuredly:--+ surely.

G3377.et: probably from the same base as (3145) and (3415) (i.e. mao, to strive)
G3377.def: probably from the same base as «3145» and «3415» (i.e. mao, to strive); to disclose (through the idea of mental effort and thus calling to mind), i.e. report, declare, intimate:--shew, tell.

G3378.def: i.e. «3361» and «3756»; as interrogative and negative, is it not that?:--neither (followed by no), + never, not. Compare «3364».

G3379.def: from «3361» and «4218»; not ever; also if (or lest) ever (or perhaps):--if peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not.

G3381.def: from «3361» and «4458»; lest somehow:--lest (by any means, by some means, haply, perhaps).

G3382.def: perhaps a primary word; a thigh:--thigh.

G3383.def: from «3361» and «5037»; not too, i.e. (in continued negation) neither or nor; also, not even:--neither, (n-)or, so as much.

G3384.def: apparently a primary word; a "mother" (literally or figuratively, immediate or remote):--mother.

G3385.def: from «3361» and the neuter of «5100»; whether at all:--not (the particle usually not expressed, except by the form of the question).

G3386.pos:
1. to say nothing of, not to mention
    1. much less
    2. much more, much rather
G3386.def: from «3385» and «1065»; not at all then, i.e. not to say (the rather still):--how much more.

G3387.def: from «3361» and «5100»; whether any:--any (sometimes unexpressed except by the simple interrogative form of the sentence).

G3389.def: from «3384» and the base of «257»; a mother-thresher, i.e. matricide:--murderer of mothers.

G3390.def: from «3384» and «4172»; a mother city, i.e. "metropolis":--chiefest city.

G3391.def: irregular feminine of «1520»; one or first:--a (certain), + agree, first, one, × other.

G3392.def: perhaps a primary verb; to sully or taint, i.e. contaminate (ceremonially or morally):--defile.

G3397.et: masculine or neuter singular of (3398) (as noun)
G3397.def: masculine or neuter singular of «3398» (as noun); a small space of time or degree:--a (little) (while).

G3398.def: apparently a primary word; small (in size, quantity, number or (figuratively) dignity):--least, less, little, small.

G3399.def: of uncertain origin; Miletus, a city of Asia Minor:--Miletus.
